backend/main.mo: Main backend canister defining story, comment, review, and user profile types with access control, submission, profile management, and basic system info endpoints.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module converting legacy story data to the new format by adding the missing authorPrincipal field set to null.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files, components, and test IDs with high confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each major frontend file including pages, components, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide explaining canister types, correct frontend canister usage, and basic deployment and troubleshooting steps.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based stylesheet defining color tokens and dark mode variables used throughout the frontend.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point that loads the React application through main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the TanStack Router configuration defining all app routes including stories, articles, admin, discussions, and submissions.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedStat: UI component displaying an access denied message with navigation back to the stories page.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Top navigation header showing site branding and links including conditional My Submissions access based on authentication.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Provides the main page layout with header, content area, and footer including navigation and contact info.
Form component for submitting new comments with validation and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/CommentThread.ts: Displays a list of comments for a story with loading skeletons and timestamp formatting.
frontend/src/components/CommentThreadDis: Shows discussion comments from all threads filtered by story title with loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/FeedDiagnosticsP: Diagnostics panel showing canister IDs and raw URLs with copy actions for troubleshooting.
frontend/src/components/ReviewComposer.t: Form component for submitting reviews with star rating, optional text, and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/ReviewThread.tsx: Displays a list of reviews for a story with ratings, timestamps, and loading states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refetching queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Hooks for fetching all stories and publishing reworded stories via actor methods with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackendAvailabilit: Hook that checks backend heartbeat availability and exposes state and refetch controls.
frontend/src/hooks/useDiscussions.ts: Hooks to load all discussions and add reviews, invalidating discussion queries on updates.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, exposing identity state and login/clear functions.
frontend/src/hooks/useStories.ts: Hooks for fetching published stories, single stories, comments, submissions, and for submitting stories or comments.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining light/dark themes, typography, and UI behavior.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point that mounts React, wrapping the app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: About page showing author background, platform purpose, and contact information.
frontend/src/pages/AdminModerationPage.t: Admin interface for reviewing, rewording, and publishing submitted stories with access control and UI states.
frontend/src/pages/ArticleDetailPage.tsx: Displays a single published story with author info, formatted date, and full comments section including composer and thread.
frontend/src/pages/ArticlesPage.tsx: Lists all published stories with loading and error states, offering navigation to individual article detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Shows author contact info, latest book details, email link, and social media buttons.
frontend/src/pages/DiscussionsPage.tsx: Aggregates discussion topics from comments and reviews, allowing users to switch modes and view related threads.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Displays a hero section and story feed with detailed error handling and backend availability diagnostics.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with hero messaging, navigation to stories and submission, plus feature highlights for sharing and discussions.
frontend/src/pages/MySubmissionsPage.tsx: Renders a user's submissions with authentication checks, loading/error states, and formatted submission list.
frontend/src/pages/StoryDetailPage.tsx: Displays a published story with metadata, handles loading/errors, and includes a comment composer and thread.
frontend/src/pages/SubmitStoryPage.tsx: Provides a story submission form with authentication, validation, submission handling, and success feedback.
frontend/src/pages/TroubleshootingPage.t: Shows canister resolution troubleshooting info, copying helpers, and canister ID details with warnings for unknown IDs.
frontend/src/utils/canisterUrls.ts: Generates and resolves frontend/backend canister IDs and URLs using hostname or env variables for troubleshooting.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters across navigation using query strings and sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s article/blog feature requirements, current state, issues, and new feature requests including email notifications.
